PLINK clumping and thresholding uses the declared independent linkage-disequilibrium
(LD) reference. The phenotype is not used to choose the threshold or variants.

## Variant retention

```{r}
# Display the PLINK variant counts used to audit score generation.
tableVIEW(
  variantFLOW[method == "plink_ct", .(
    cohort,
    trait_id,
    prs_name,
    stage,
    variant_count,
    percent_of_source
  )],
  "PLINK variant retention."
)
```

## Method files

```{r}
# Provide PLINK weights, reference results, checks, and logs.
fileTABLE(
  "^(plink_ct|reference/plink_ct|qc/plink_ct|logs/plink_ct)",
  "PLINK weights, reference results, quality checks, and logs."
)
```
